title: gomphrena agrestis var. genuina
intro: Gomphrena agrestis var. genuina, commonly known as Red Star or Gomphena, is a plant species in the Amaranthaceae family. It is a type of succulent herb that is traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary purposes. The health benefits of Gomphrena agrestis var. genuina include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and betalains.
